name: chirp_purge_aggregate
description: Runbook row: Purge backlog and blocked work (MONITORING-RUNBOOK.md, Current-service signal plan). Extracts status from chirp-purge's single stdout JSON report line (backend/app/jobs/purge.py) on Cloud Run Jobs. Risk: Cloud Run Jobs stdout-to-jsonPayload promotion is assumed by analogy with Cloud Run Services and is not separately verified in this change; validate this time series exists after the first successful dedicated-identity run (c369) before activating the referencing alert policy.
filter: resource.type="cloud_run_job" AND resource.labels.job_name="chirp-purge" AND jsonPayload.status:* AND jsonPayload.batches_committed:*

labels.description: purge job report status: preview, complete, blocked, incomplete, timed_out or failed
